info.title: PayU Hosted Checkout API
info.description: API specification for PayU Hosted Checkout where payment method selection and card details are captured on PayU's side.

post.description: Process a payment using PayU Hosted Checkout

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Merchant key provided by PayU during onboarding.

parameters.name: txnid
parameters.description: The transaction ID is a reference number for the transaction.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The payment amount for the transaction.

parameters.name: productinfo
parameters.description: A brief description of the product.

parameters.name: firstname
parameters.description: The first name of the customer.

parameters.name: surl
parameters.description: The success URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to after a successful payment.

parameters.name: furl
parameters.description: The Failure URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to after a failed payment.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email address of the customer.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: The hash calculated by the merchant for secure transactions.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: The phone number of the customer.

parameters.name: lastname
parameters.description: The last name of the customer.

parameters.name: buyer_type_business
parameters.description: This parameter is used to identify whether it is a business-to-business transaction.

parameters.name: curl
parameters.description: The Cancel URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the customer cancels the payment.

parameters.name: udf1
parameters.description: User-defined field 1 for storing additional information about the transaction.

parameters.name: udf2
parameters.description: User-defined field 2 for storing additional information about the transaction.

parameters.name: udf3
parameters.description: User-defined field 3 for storing additional information about the transaction.

parameters.name: udf4
parameters.description: User-defined field 4 for storing additional information about the transaction.

parameters.name: udf5
parameters.description: User-defined field 5 for storing additional information about the transaction.

parameters.name: lrs_service_type
parameters.description: The LRS service type decides the tax amount based on the nature of business. The accepted values are: education_loan, education_non_loan, medical, travel, others.

200.description: Successful response - Customer will be redirected to payment page

400.description: Bad request - Request parameters are invalid
